title: FREE covers comparing. PRO removes the limits on keeping track.
lead: Both plans rank every product in your country with full results. PRO is for people who watch many products and prices.
price_note: Price for information. With a display currency the amount is converted and the native price is shown with it.
how_to_get_pro: Online payment is not available yet. PRO is activated with a promo code, or by the VitaDelta team on request. When the PRO period ends, your account returns to FREE automatically; nothing is deleted.
how_to_get_pro_online: Subscribe online on the secure payment page of our payment provider, Stripe, or activate PRO with a promo code. The subscription renews every month until you cancel it; after the last paid month your account returns to FREE automatically and nothing is deleted.

checkout.note: You pay on the secure Stripe page; VitaDelta never sees your card details. Renews monthly, cancel any time from your account.
checkout.already_pro: PRO is already active on your account.
checkout.unsettled_title: A paid subscription is still open
checkout.unsettled_text: Your account still has a Stripe subscription that has not ended, for example an unpaid renewal, or your last payment is still being confirmed. Settle it in the billing portal instead of starting a second subscription.

return.confirming_text: This usually takes a few seconds.
return.active_until: PRO is active until {{ date }}. Your new limits apply now.
return.pending_text: Your plan changes as soon as the payment service confirms the payment, usually within a minute. You will also get an e-mail when PRO is active.
return.signed_out_title: Log in to see your plan
return.signed_out_text: Your plan changes as soon as the payment is confirmed. Log in to check it.
return.canceled_text: No payment was made and your plan did not change.

signin_text: Promo codes are redeemed in your account. Create a free account or log in to enter a code.
